new.md: Creates a new popover bin widget.

doc.brief: A single child container with a popover.
doc.md:
A single child container with a popover.

You should use `GtkPopoverBin` whenever you need to present a [`Popover`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Popover)
to the user.

## Actions

`GtkPopoverBin` defines the `menu.popup` action, which can be activated
to present the popover to the user.

## CSS nodes

`GtkPopoverBin` has a single CSS node with the name `popoverbin`.

popdown.md:
Hides the popover from the user.

See: [`PopoverBin.popup()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:popup)

popup.brief: Presents the popover to the user.
popup.md:
Presents the popover to the user.

Use [`PopoverBin.set_popover()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:set_popover) or
[`PopoverBin.set_menu_model()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:set_menu_model) to define the popover.

See: [`PopoverBin.popdown()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:popdown)

set_child.brief: Sets the child of the popover bin.
set_child.md: Sets the child of the popover bin.

set_handle_input.md:
Enables or disables input handling.

If enabled, the popover bin will pop up the
popover on right-click or long press, as expected
for a context menu.

set_menu_model.brief: Sets the menu model used to create the popover that will be presented when calling [`PopoverBin.popup()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:popup).
set_menu_model.md:
Sets the menu model used to create the popover that will be
presented when calling [`PopoverBin.popup()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:popup).

If `model` is `NULL`, the popover will be unset.

A [`Popover`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Popover) will be created from the menu model with
[`PopoverMenu.new_from_model()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverMenu#constructor:new_from_model). Actions will be connected
as documented for this function.

If [`PopoverBin:popover`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#property:popover) is already set, it will be
dissociated from the popover bin, and the property is set to `NULL`.

See: [`PopoverBin.set_popover()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:set_popover)

set_popover.brief: Sets the `GtkPopover` that will be presented when calling [`PopoverBin.popup()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:popup).
set_popover.md:
Sets the `GtkPopover` that will be presented when calling
[`PopoverBin.popup()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:popup).

If `popover` is `NULL`, the popover will be unset.

If [`PopoverBin:menu-model`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#property:menu-model) is set before calling
this function, then the menu model property will be unset.

See: [`PopoverBin.set_menu_model()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverBin#method:set_menu_model)
